T-CASE-0.initial: Independent layer/cassette geometry and open cassette on level surface.
T-CASE-0.action: Assemble six layers, trace roller across stack, close hinge, engage latch and lift50 mm.
T-CASE-0.observable: Layer order, planar overlap, compression and retention.
T-CASE-0.pass_condition: Order from gray side exactly pad/paper/gel/membrane/paper/pad; membrane covers gel outline with edge mismatch<=0.5 mm; closing/lifting changes layer pose<=0.5 mm and1 deg; latch stays engaged and verified compression/hinge limits respected. Missing layer truth blocks.
T-CASE-0.note: Test conditions and tolerances, not manufacturer performance.

T-CASE-1.initial: Two closed cassettes, independent tank/module/cooling geometry.
T-CASE-1.action: Insert cassettes and cooling block, assign fill to mark, check stir-bar swept envelope using independent accessory fixture.
T-CASE-1.observable: Membrane/electrode order, slot seating and clearances.
T-CASE-1.pass_condition: Membrane lies on anode side of gel in both cassettes; seat mismatch<=0.5 mm; no unintended overlap>0.2 mm; stir-bar envelope clear>=1 mm; declared fill matches independently measured mark within1 mm. Unknown bar SKU/mark prevents completion.
T-CASE-1.note: Test conditions and tolerances, not manufacturer performance.

T-CASE-2.action: Close lid and virtual-run; test disconnected-contact fault; execute normal off/unplug/open/remove sequence.
T-CASE-2.pass_condition: Any disconnected required lid contact breaks circuit within1 ms B step; normal opening follows power-off and unplug; no transfer-success claim arises from virtual run completion.
T-CASE-2.note: Test conditions and tolerances, not manufacturer performance.
